name: Mayuzumi Shion
source:
"You're the only one who's allowed to touch me"
Keyword: Forgive

Basically, he's satisfied as long as he's being loved. 
The tolerance level to his lover is infinitely large, but he has a surprising indifference to people outside his territory.
